faqs.question: How can I join a group buying pool?
faqs.answer: Open 'Active Pools' and add items to your cart. Once the pool target is met, the bulk order is placed at wholesale rates.

faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity for wholesale prices?
faqs.answer: No minimum. Pool with other retailers and buy even 1 unit at the wholesale rate.

faqs.question: How long does order delivery take?
faqs.answer: Within 24 to 48 business hours after the pool locks.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my pooled order?
faqs.answer: Yes, free of charge before the pool locks. After that, cancellation is not allowed.

faqs.question: How do I verify I am getting genuine wholesale pricing?
faqs.answer: The app shows both the retail market price and our pooled wholesale price, so you can check your margin before ordering.

faqs.question: Which cities and areas do you currently serve?
faqs.answer: Major commercial hubs across Pakistan. Enter your postal code in the app to check coverage.

faqs.question: What happens if a product goes out of stock in wholesale market?
faqs.answer: You are notified instantly and any advance payment is fully refunded to your wallet or bank.

faqs.question: How do I track customer credit and payments in Digital Khata?
faqs.answer: Open 'Digital Khata', tap 'Add Customer', and log credit, payments and dues.

faqs.question: Is my business ledger and customer credit data secure?
faqs.answer: Yes. Your data is encrypted and backed up daily to secure cloud storage.

faqs.question: Can I send automated payment reminder bills to customers?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send reminders with ledger statements via WhatsApp or SMS in one click.

faqs.question: Do you offer credit or installment financing for shopkeepers?
faqs.answer: Purchases start on cash terms. Active group-buying retailers become eligible for credit limits.

faqs.question: What payment methods are accepted for bulk orders?
faqs.answer: Cash on Delivery, bank transfer (IBFT), EasyPaisa and JazzCash.

faqs.question: Are there any hidden membership or service charges?
faqs.answer: No. Membership and Digital Khata are free. Only a small delivery fee is shown before checkout.

faqs.question: What is the return policy for damaged or defective items?
faqs.answer: Submit photo proof in 'Help & Claims' within 24 hours of delivery for a replacement or instant refund.

faqs.question: How quickly are refunds processed?
faqs.answer: Wallet refunds are instant. Bank refunds take 2 to 3 working days.

faqs.question: How can I register my shop on the DigiBuzz B2B Network?
faqs.answer: Download the app and enter your phone number, shop name and address. Your account activates immediately.

faqs.question: Can I record ledger transactions offline without internet?
faqs.answer: Yes. Offline entries sync automatically when you reconnect.

faqs.question: What should I do if the app is slow or facing technical errors?
faqs.answer: Update the app or clear the cache. If it continues, contact our technical helpline.

faqs.question: What are your operating hours for deliveries and customer support?
faqs.answer: Support: 9 AM to 6 PM, Monday to Saturday. Deliveries: 10 AM to 8 PM daily.

faqs.question: Can I speak directly with a human representative or manager?
faqs.answer: Transferring you to our human support manager. Please stay on the line.
